title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: graph connector prompts in the Prompt Gallery for Copilot Chat
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, connector licensing, deployment role and Prompt Gallery background match the sources checked. Searches found no documentation specifying the new prompts' default, visibility controls or feature-specific licensing, and the page keeps those gaps separate from documented connector requirements.
